title: IMTC, MarketAxess Enter Relationship to Enhance Liquidity, Scale Custom Fixed Income Portfolios
summary: /PRNewswire-PRWeb/ -- IMTC, the fixed income technology platform trusted by buy‑side portfolio managers, today announced an integration with MarketAxess...
body_markdown:
Integration links IMTC's platform with MarketAxess' global electronic trading network to help institutions trade more efficiently and improve execution quality.


NEW YORK


, Sept. 9, 2026


/PRNewswire-PRWeb/ -- IMTC, the fixed income technology platform trusted by buy‑side portfolio managers, today announced an integration with MarketAxess Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: MKTX), a leading institutional electronic trading platform for global fixed income markets, to enhance liquidity opportunities for market participants.
